Four test files import `findEnclosingSgSymbols` from `src/sg.ts` and call it directly:

- `tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts`: calls it directly. It also has a test, "ast_search tool derives enclosing symbols before display range merging", that reaches it through the `ast_search` tool.
- `tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts`
- `tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts`
- `tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts`

The only other caller in `src` is the `ast_search` tool (`src/sg.ts:415`). It calls the function only when `PI_CONTEXT_HYGIENE_DEBUG=1` is set and the number of matched files is under a cap. Of the many tests that run `ast_search`, only `context-hygiene-sg.test.ts` sets that variable. Three other tests mention the variable but never run the tool, so they don't reach this function.

I found these by searching the code and haven't run any of them. To rerun all four:
`npx vitest run tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts`
